about_the_game:
Nothing beats a few brewskis on a temperate summer evening while camping in northern Ontario, however a rustle in the bushes reveals an onslaught of monsters who seek to separate your beer from your hand! Respond the natural way by taking up arms and defending yourself from this travesty!

In this comedic-horror roguelike shooter you must make your final stand into the night, watching in all directions while manually going through the meticulous process of each step in loading and firing your guns as quickly as possible before the creatures of the night catch you. As you progress, the intensity of the monsters ramps up until you are overwhelmed. Earn points by shooting monsters and aim for as high of a score as you can and beat your friends' scores!

How long will your cold ones survive?
